{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Rice|Rice]]

'''Pandora's feast''' is a complete vegan meal that can be served several times a week due to the ease with which it can be modified.  The meal is easy to prepare in a [[Cookbook:Rice Cooker|rice cooker]].

==Ingredients==

=== Base ===
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] uncooked [[Cookbook:Rice|brown rice]]
*2 cups water

=== Additions ===
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Soaking Beans|soaked]] and [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiled]] [[Cookbook:Black Bean|black]], [[Cookbook:Pinto Bean|pinto]], [[Cookbook:Kidney Bean|kidney]] or other [[Cookbook:Bean|beans]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]] [[Cookbook:Potato|potato]]
*1 cup cubed [[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|sweet potato]]
*1 cup cubed [[Cookbook:Squash|squash]]
*1 clove [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
*1 cup cubed [[Cookbook:Beet|beet]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Kale|kale]]

=== Serving ===
*[[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]], hemp oil, flaxseed oil, or other nutritious [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]]
*[[Cookbook:Nutritional Yeast|Nutritional yeast]]
*[[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|Soy sauce]]
*Black [[Cookbook:Sesame Seed|sesame seeds]]

==Procedure==

#Add the brown rice and water to a [[Cookbook:Rice Cooker|rice cooker]].
#Drain, rinse, and add the beans to the rice cooker.
#If using, add the garlic to the cooker.
#If using, add the sweet potato, squash, beet, or potato.
#If using a fuzzy logic (i.e. programmable) cooker, set the cooker to the brown rice setting and turn it on. If using an on/off cooker, simply turn it on.
#In about 20–40 minutes, your cooker should finish cooking the rice. When finished, open the lid, add the kale, close the lid, and wait about another minute or two.
#Open and serve. Top with oil, yeast, soy sauce and/or sesame seeds, to taste.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If you have "Thai sweet black rice" or "Chinese forbidden black rice", replace about 10% of your brown rice with this, and your finished product will be a lovely purple and will have a different taste.
* The beans must be either pre-soaked for at least 8 hours and [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiled]] briskly for 20 minutes (preferred) or from a can. It is important to soak and pre-cook dried beans. Dried kidney beans will cause nausea, vomiting and diarrhea unless they have been boiled briskly for at least 20 minutes to destroy the very indigestible phytohaemagglutinin that they contain (the slow cooker will not do and can even make things worse). They will then need another 60–90 minutes at a slow [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] to be tender. Tinned kidney beans are quite safe and do not need pre-cooking, as their preparation involves sufficient heat to destroy the toxin.)
* The cubed vegetables should be 1[[Cookbook:cm|cm]] x 1cm for optimal cooking.

steps.text: Add the brown rice and water to a rice cooker.
Drain, rinse, and add the beans to the rice cooker.
If using, add the garlic to the cooker.
If using, add the sweet potato, squash, beet, or potato.
If using a fuzzy logic (i.e. programmable) cooker, set the cooker to the brown rice setting and turn it on. If using an on/off cooker, simply turn it on.
In about 20–40 minutes, your cooker should finish cooking the rice. When finished, open the lid, add the kale, close the lid, and wait about another minute or two.
Open and serve. Top with oil, yeast, soy sauce and/or sesame seeds, to taste.
